sections.Profile:
The "Mustang" pinball machine, released by Chicago Coin Machine Mfg. Co. in October 1964, is a two-player, electro-mechanical game with a car culture theme. Designed by Al Schlappa and Jerry Koci, it features two flippers, one pop bumper, two scoring bumpers, two slingshots, three standup targets, and a revolving target carousel.
